basis: Local repair of original reconstructed geometry, not a new reconstruction or measured survey

courtyard.repair: Relocate blue sky above 1.8m to at least 65m radius about the capture eye, preserving angular position and Gaussian footprint. Tree, ground and water are unchanged.

living.repair: Fill missing island side, cabinet base and occluded floor strip from existing concept geometry and photographed material colors. Remove 780 unsupported splats only within the missing-side slab; keep the original floor and remaining furniture.

validation.offline: CPU anisotropic Gaussian comparison from reported problem angle and original capture position. Tree occlusion reproduces before repair and disappears after sky-depth correction. Kitchen side closure substantially removes the white void.
validation.browser: Not verified: existing browser policy restriction; no alternate browser path used.
